_doc: One file per web app. A new tool = a new file like this one; nothing in code changes. Omit 'agent' to run without a model.
jql: parent = DWQ-129 AND labels in ("automate", "execute") ORDER BY key ASC
_auth: No login on this portal. For apps that need one: loginFile = steps whose values are ENV:NAME tokens, envFile = the framework's .env.
_environment: QA = the portal run locally with ./dev.sh in MAC mode (frontend 127.0.0.1:3000, backends 127.0.0.1:8000-8002). 172.22.64.228 is PROD: never point a profile at it with allowWrites.
